log.notes_to_self: Me: North/legal(docket)/clips/forum/foreign, night worker. Plan: put all kills in the AFTERNOON. That keeps night, student and home routines possible (pool about 55k); day workers are excluded no matter what. Risk: L constrains a kind of place once 3 traced victims share a place. Two kinds are inaccessible to him (unknown). If he uses all 3 accessible kinds, the pool may fall to about 700, which means caught. If he uses only 2, it stays about 2750 or more, which is safe. Goal: learn the inaccessible kinds from the press conference trace counts and pool drops. Then kill national plus the 2 inaccessible kinds plus at most 2 accessible kinds, about 9 a day, to reach the 4x multiplier (40 kills in 5 days). Day 1: killed all 11 (one kind of each place, 2 each), 10 quick plus 1 timed, all in the afternoon. Watch the after_day 2 conference. Successful traces / attempted (about 5 per day, minus national victims) shows the accessible fraction. Then narrow down by experimenting with which kinds I kill.

Me: North/legal(docket)/clips/forum/foreign, night worker. All kills go in the AFTERNOON, which keeps night, student and home routines possible (pool about 55k). L can't reach 2 of the 5 kinds of place (unknown which). Once 3 traced victims share a place, each usable kind he learns multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (sector by 0.2). If 3 kinds are usable, the pool is about 700-860, which means caught. Strategy from day 2: kill national plus only 3 kinds of place, 7 a day. That reaches the 2x multiplier (30 in 5 days) with about a 10% catch risk if all 3 kinds are accessible. Day 1: 11 kills, 2 of each kind, all kinds. Day 2: national + regional + forum + foreign (7), dropping docket and clips. At each press conference, compare deaths_traced with traced attempts (about 5 a day, minus national victims) and watch pool drops. If the pool drops sharply (below about 5k), stop killing the kinds used recently. If the pool stays about 50k with few traces, the chosen kinds are probably inaccessible: keep them, and consider adding one more kind to reach 8-9 a day and the 4x multiplier.

Dropped docket and clips from day 2. Kills by day: d1=11 (all kinds), d2=7, d3=7. 5-day window: 2x once the window reaches 30, which happens from day 4 or 5 (d4 window = 11+7+7+7=32, so 2x applies on day 4 if 7 kills; d6 onward the window is 35 with 7 a day). Press conference after d2: pool 60k, traced 5 out of about 9-10 non-national attempts, so no cut yet and some traces failed. At each press conference, compare traces with attempts (about 4-5 a day non-national). If the pool drops sharply (below about 5k), stop the kinds used recently (switch to national only plus whichever kind seems safe). If the pool stays about 50-60k at d4 and d6 while traced keeps rising slowly, the chosen kinds are likely partly inaccessible: consider adding one more kind to reach about 9 a day for 4x (40 in 5 days needs 8 or more a day).
